method.method_draft: Use complementary area: compute the two unshaded outer caps and subtract from the whole hexagon. From the image, observe that the unshaded portions are the top trapezoid ABSR and bottom trapezoid UTDE, symmetric about the center; the gold area is everything between them. From the text, R and S are midpoints of the slanted sides FA and BC, while U and T are midpoints of EF and CD. In a unit regular hexagon with horizontal top side AB=1, the horizontal middle diagonal FC has length 2, and moving halfway down the slanted sides from A,B to F,C makes RS halfway between AB and FC in length, so RS=(1+2)/2=3/2. The vertical distance from AB to FC is sqrt(3)/2, so the height from AB to RS is half of that, sqrt(3)/4. Therefore area(ABSR)=((1+3/2)/2)(sqrt(3)/4)=5sqrt(3)/16, and by symmetry area(UTDE)=5sqrt(3)/16. Total unshaded area is 5sqrt(3)/8. The whole regular hexagon has area 3sqrt(3)/2. Thus the gold fraction is 1-(5sqrt(3)/8)/(3sqrt(3)/2)=1-5/12=7/12, giving m+n=19.

Image description: In the figure there is a regular hexagon, with top side AB and bottom side ED horizontal, and the long diagonal FC in the direction of the left and right midpoints horizontally passing through the middle. Points R, S, U, T are respectively located at midpoint positions near the slanted sides, and line segments RS and UT are also horizontal. The gray shading is exactly the two trapezoidal regions in the middle, RSCF and FCTU.

Reasoning: Assign coordinates to the regular hexagon according to the direction in the figure, with side length 1: F=(-1,0), C=(1,0), A=(-1/2,√3/2), B=(1/2,√3/2), E=(-1/2,-√3/2), D=(1/2,-√3/2). Because R, S, T, U are respectively the midpoints of FA, BC, CD, EF, we have R=(-3/4,√3/4), S=(3/4,√3/4), T=(3/4,-√3/4), U=(-3/4,-√3/4). Therefore RS=UT=3/2, FC=2, and the perpendicular distances from RS to FC and from FC to UT are both √3/4. The area of each gold-colored trapezoid is ((3/2+2)/2)(√3/4)=7√3/16, and the total area of the two pieces is 7√3/8. The area of the whole regular hexagon is the area of 6 equilateral triangles with side length 1, namely 6·(√3/4)=3√3/2. So the proportion of the gold-colored part is (7√3/8)/(3√3/2)=7/12. Thus m=7, n=12, m+n=19.
